mark.does: The two commonest figures on a Burmese thigh, named in the same breath as tigers and elephants.

text.what: The two commonest figures on a Burmese thigh, named in the same breath as tigers and elephants.
text.story: The name of the animal is often written inside the figure as well, which Shway Yoe compares, drily, to a child labelling a drawing.
